meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", "share skills", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

copy.tagline: 用命令行操控Orca的代码、终端和AI助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在Orca里管理多个开发任务,想要用命令行统一控制
copy.tagline_en: Manage Orca's code workspaces, terminals, and AI agents via CLI.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Orca to manage multiple dev tasks and want CLI control.

howto.what: Claude 会先用电脑上正确的 orca 小工具把配套使用说明取回来，再照着说明操作，而不是自己猜步骤；如果这个小工具无法运行，就报告错误并停下。
howto.when: 当你说出“$orca-cli”“Orca worktree”“full handoff”等触发词，或请它操作 Orca 管理的工作区、终端、内置浏览器等时触发；这类任务优先于 git worktree、Playwright。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 列出现有的工作区和终端。
say.note: 将先拉取完整 CLI 指南再执行列表操作。

say.text: 把当前任务完整交接给另一个工作区的 agent，用 full handoff。
say.note: 会按指南执行 full handoff 交接。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 控制 Orca 内置浏览器打开网页。
say.note: 会转向 Orca 内置浏览器并打开页面。

howto.what_en: For Orca-related tasks, Claude first uses the correct orca tool on the machine to fetch the matching usage guide, then follows it instead of guessing steps. If the tool cannot run, it reports the error and stops.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “$orca-cli”, “Orca worktree”, “full handoff”, or requests touching Orca-managed state; preferred over raw git worktree/Playwright in such contexts.

say_en.text: List the current Orca worktrees and terminals with orca-cli.
say_en.note: Loads the full CLI guide first, then lists them.

say_en.text: Hand off this task to another agent in a worktree using full handoff.
Use orca-cli to control Orca's built-in browser and open a webpage.
